thread:
Mara: Quick weekly health check for AcmeCorp — tokens + throughput trends (QoQ / WoW). Renewal in ~6 weeks, want to surface risks and next actions. TL;DR: tokens rising, throughput up, 95th latency spikes on embeddings intermittently.
Tony: Pasting the numbers I pulled from the usage dashboard. small notes inline.
Tony: ```
- Periods: WoW (last 7d vs prior 7d), QoQ (this quarter vs last)
- Avg tokens/day: 1.2M (WoW +12%, QoQ +38%)
- Peak RPS (generation endpoints): 310 rps (WoW +9%)
- Embedding calls/day: 42k (WoW +5%, QoQ +22%)
- 95th latency (generation): 420ms (WoW +3%)
- 95th latency (embeddings): 1.8s (WoW +28% -> suspicious)
- Error rate (5xx): generation 0.2% (steady), embeddings 1.6% (spike last 48h)
- Spend MoM: +18% (driven by token growth and more embedding usage)
```
Priya: Thanks Tony. That embeddings 95th latency +1.8s and 1.6% errors is the main risk. Do we know if it's localized to a region or model variant?
Tony: Quick breakdown: region-wise last 48h for embeddings
Tony: ```
- us-west-2: 70% of calls, 95th latency 1.9s, error rate 1.8%
- eu-west-1: 20% of calls, 95th latency 1.2s, error rate 0.6%
- ap-southeast-1: 10% of calls, 95th latency 1.3s, error rate 0.7%
- Primary model used: embed-v2-base (quantized). No rollout changes on their account.
```
Devon: @Mara could be capacity issue on our dedicated nodes in us-west-2 for their Dedicated pool? Any autoscale alerts?
UsageBot: [alert] autoscale-trigger: dedicated-pool-acmecorp-usw2 scaled from 8 -> 12 GPUs at 2024-05-10T09:14:20Z :arrow_up_small:
Mara: We saw an autoscale event yesterday morning (UsageBot) but the error spike persisted after scale — suggests an infra/network flakiness or model kernel fallback. Can eng-runtime investigate?
Priya: From product side I want to know if this is affecting cost forecast for renewal. Tony, can you give a 4-week projection at current trajectory?
Tony: Projection quick take: formula = current avg tokens/day * 28 * growth factor (using QoQ trend smoothed).
Tony: ```
- Current avg tokens/day 1.2M -> 28d = 33.6M tokens
- If QoQ growth continues (~+38% relative quarter): conservative projection +20% next 4w -> ~40.3M tokens
- Embedded call growth similarly implies embedding spend +~25% next 4w
```
Mara: Ok — that math puts them well above the committed tier next month unless they upgrade. Risk: renewal conversation could surface unexpected overages.
Devon: Accepting this as priority. @eng-runtime should check kernel fallback logs for embed-v2-base on their pool and validate NVLink contention. I'll open an issue.
Tony: Also flag: their traffic pattern shows more small-batch embedding calls (batch size 1-2) which increases per-call overhead -> explains latency jump.
Priya: Two immediate CS actions: 1) schedule an enablement session with Acme devs on batching best practices and SDK retries, 2) coordinate with Solutions to propose a Dedicated capacity bump + autoscale policy tweak. Mara taking lead on 1, Devon on 2?
Mara: I'll reach out to their engineering lead today to propose a 30-min sync. I'll include simple tips: batch embeddings, enable async bulk upload, and set exponential backoff for 429/5xx.
Devon: I'll draft the Dedicated autoscale recommendation and cost delta for +20% cap.
Tony: Follow-ups for eng-runtime: can we add short-term mitigation — server-side prefix caching for frequent embedding inputs? That would reduce traffic.
Priya: Also capture customer sentiment: last week their AE said "happy with perf", but this week's anomalies might change tone. Mara, can you add a note to CR (customer record) and flag renewal risk as 'medium' pending infra findings?
Mara: Yep — updating CR after this thread. Renewal risk = medium (due to potential overage + lat spikes).
Tony: I'll attach a CSV of raw daily metrics to the CR.
Mara: Next sync: Friday 11:00am PT to decide if we proactively propose upgrade or wait for fixes. If eng-runtime finds infra root cause, we hold off.
UsageBot: [report] weekly-account-health report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/reports/acmecorp/week-17 :pushpin:
Priya: Thanks all. Quick ask: can we include a one-slide graph (WoW token trend + embedding 95th latency overlay) for the renewal packet? I'll mock it if Tony can't.
Tony: I can make a quick graph by EOD.
Mara: Great. Closing notes: immediate owner list -> Mara (CS lead) action: customer enablement / CR update; Devon (Infra) action: open eng-runtime incident; Tony (Data) action: attach CSV + chart; Priya (Solutions) action: propose Dedicated tweak.
Mara: Thanks team :thumbsup:
Tony: :rocket:
